description: Selection of a numeric range with two bounds and keyboard support.

howToUse: Use it to pick a range between two values: price, distance, area.
Give it a `label` and format the values with `formatValue` ("R$ 200", "5 km").
Add `histogram` to show how many results fall in each part of the range, and `ticks` for reference marks.
Use `fixedMinimum` when only the upper end changes, such as a radius from zero.
alternatives: An exact number that people type: Input with `type="number"`.

keyboard.action: Moves from the lower handle to the upper handle.
Moves the handle in focus by one step. With `Shift`, by ten steps.
Goes to the lowest or highest allowed value. The two handles never cross.

props.name: step
props.description: Keyboard and value grid increment. Default 1.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.

props.name: label
props.description: Control name, shown above the track.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats each end in the readout/aria (e.g. `(v) => v + "k"`).

props.name: fixedMinimum
props.description: Fixes the minimum and exposes only the end handle (e.g. radius 0 → 2 km).

props.name: histogram
props.description: Mini distribution above the track; bars inside the range light up.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.
